verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a REST API (Cloud API) for creating and managing on-demand instances and clusters, plus cloud-init for workload bootstrap, which covers provisioning and run steps without a human in the console (lambda-labs-docs-5, -23, -31, -39, -6, -24). However, monitoring is largely console-based (Usage page, DCGM Grafana dashboards tied to Kubernetes) rather than a general programmatic monitoring API, there is no official CLI, and MCP support is only community-built/unofficial (lambda-labs-comm-1), with a documented real-world gap where Lambda does not auto-detect idle instances for teardown, requiring manual intervention (lambda-labs-comm-2). Missing for 10: official CLI, official MCP server, a documented instance-level monitoring API, and automated/idle-based teardown support.
